metadata.description: Claude Code plugin for looking ultra-focused while Claude does the hard work. While Claude is working, a whack-a-mole game appears above your prompt. It looks like agent output and uses your session's real prompts, tool calls and replies. Now and then a character slowly turns into a little mole. Hover over it to whack it. Unofficial, not affiliated with Anthropic.
